pattern: Named group of images: role=group with aria-label; each avatar is role=img named by its person; the overflow chip is role=img named 'N more'.

keyboard.action: Not focusable; read in document order by assistive technology.

notes: The overflow chip says how many people are not shown; provide the full list elsewhere when users need the names.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
